After Tokai Teio was defeated by Mejiro 
McQueen, McQueen declared to her, "No 
matter how many times we race, the outcome 
will never change."

Determined to make her acknowledge her 
true strength somehow, Tokai Teio decides 
to enter the Japan Cup.

A few days later... Tokai Teio was 
training desperately, but Symboli Rudolf 
delivered a harsh assessment of her 
efforts.

The difference in ability between Tokai 
Teio and Mejiro McQueen was vast, and no 
matter how many times they raced, she 
likely wouldn't be able to beat Mejiro 
McQueen.

Tokai Teio's challenge heading toward the 
Japan Cup began with an ominous sense of 
turmoil.
